name: Detonation at a Distance
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator - why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
narrative.objectives: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hmm... Looking for something specific, are you?

chain.subtitle: 11 quests from level 12 to 18, 8,235 XP in all.

quests.name: Testing the Wells
quests.objectiveText: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.

quests.name: Murloc Gills
quests.objectiveText: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of Westfall.

quests.name: The State of the Mines
quests.objectiveText: Slay 4 Kobold Diggers in the Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners in the Gold Coast Quarry.

quests.name: Moonbrook Espionage
quests.objectiveText: Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies from Moonbrook.

quests.name: Explosive Consultation
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help.

quests.name: A Dynamite Plan
quests.objectiveText: Obtain 10 Coarse Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Detonation at a Distance
quests.objectiveText: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.

quests.name: Detonation at a Distance
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Remote Detonator Kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Explosive Consultation
quests.objectiveText: Return to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.

quests.name: Destruction in Deadmines
quests.objectiveText: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby.
